meta.name: Girgit
meta.description:
The storyline of the show revolves around the couple Ranbir and Janvi. They seem like any other normal couple from the outside, but, in reality, are highly dysfunctional. They plot and plan together against every person they know, until they turn against one another too. The love which they felt for each other evaporates into nothingness and obsession takes over. A dysfunctional but happy marriage turns into a battleground and a stalking pit. Who would come out of this alive? Who is more dangerous, Ranbir or Janvi? What are they going to do to one another?

Rated A · Ended · First aired 27 Oct 2021 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: ALTBalaji · Network: ALTBalaji, MX Player

videos.title: Till Death Do Us Part
videos.overview: Ranbir decides to spend his life with Avantika. However, on the day of their engagement, he comes across some information that starts a storm in his life. When Lyndoh devices him, Ranbir does something that brings his true personality to light. What does Ranbir do? What is the new information?

videos.title: Black-mail
videos.overview: Shamoli and Mahi try to lure Candy into their trap but soon they realise that she is onto something much bigger than their situation. Ranbir tries to make peace with Avantika but something else is going on in his head. What is Ranbir upto?

videos.title: Gaslighting
videos.overview: Ranbir races against the clock as he has only a few hours to save Candy. However, he is in shock when he comes to know about Shamoli’s planning. Ranbir loses his calm and gets Mahi at gunpoint. What will he do next?

videos.title: Big Little Lies
videos.overview: Ranbir comes face to face with Janvi. Moshe makes a big move under pressure and this leaves Mahi in a dilemma. Avantika also gets the biggest shock of her life when Ranbir reveals something big to her. What does Ranbir say to Avantika?

videos.title: Partner In Crime
videos.overview: Ranbir and Janvi are both trying to stop the other from carrying out their plan. However, in the end, they both fail to outrun each other and the plans are carried out. In the meanwhile, Mahi falls for the trap that Ranbir had been scheming. Even after she falls for Ranbir’s evil plan, something unexpected happens as Mahi takes a step nobody had thought about. What did Mahi do?

videos.title: Crime Of Passion
videos.overview: Janvi is dead set on moving forward with her plans and there is nothing that can be done to change her mind. Rathod faces a problem as he loses his support, his ally to aid him. Ranbir and Janvi also try to sort things out and a peace treaty is proposed between each other. While all this is going on, Mahi realizes that she has been trapped and betrayed. What will she do after this realization? What will Mahi’s next step be?

videos.title: Sociopath
videos.overview: Ranbir and Rathod learn a shocking secret as they unveil the person behind the Chinese mask. Ranbir is in a state of shock as he had never expected this to happen. He is living his worst nightmare and the only way out for him is to have a new start. However, will he be able to forget the demons of his past and begin a new life? Who was the person responsible for the Chinese mask? Was it Janvi? What has happened to her?
